subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this stay as a distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` recovery and `chat.history` pressure issue, or should maintainers fold the remaining work into the existing guarded-lane, ambiguous-delivery, and Dashboard flood issues?
rationale: Source evidence proves the shared ambiguous-send guard is still present, but the report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI load amplifier that no single related item fully owns.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Issue
options.body: Keep this issue open as the proof and design home for Telegram reasoning preview/final delivery under ambiguous sends, cross-linked to the existing delivery and Dashboard reports.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Issues
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only if maintainers decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87552, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99650 together fully own the remaining work.

options.title: Split UI Pressure Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and route the `chat.history` burst evidence to the Dashboard flooding issue if maintainers want separate ownership.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the proof and design home for Telegram reasoning preview/final delivery under ambiguous sends, cross-linked to the existing delivery and Dashboard reports.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared outbound recovery semantics, Telegram delivery safety, and Control UI history behavior where steipete has recent cross-boundary history.
